field_orientation.current_player: the acting side; it does not change field orientation
field_orientation.opponent_pits: fixed player-1 pits, indices 0..5 in sowing order
field_orientation.player_pits: fixed player-0 pits, indices 0..5 in sowing order
field_orientation.policy_indices: indices 0..5 are relative to current_player; index 0 is that side's first pit

output_encoding: policy_f32_hex is six little-endian IEEE-754 float32 values; value_f64_hex is one little-endian IEEE-754 float64
